evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of persistent fatigue with a strong family history of
early heart disease.

Findings: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 84 bpm. Normal
axis.PR interval 180 ms, QRS 81 ms, QTc 459 ms.
Impression: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes and no acute changes.

Transthoracic echo this admission: LVEF 30%. Mild left atrial enlargement. Severely
reduced left ventricular systolic function.

EXAM:
General: comfortable at rest.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic mumur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: no peripheral edema.

EXAM:
General: well appcaring, no distress.
Neck: no carotid bruits.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, grade 2/6 systolic ejection
rnurmur, no radiation.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.
